assignments.name: canceled
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const v = $('Preparar Item').item.json.canceled; if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v; const s = String(v ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(); return s === 'true' || s === '1'; })() }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Config Piloto').first().json; const single = c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM === true || String(c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM).toLowerCase() === 'true'; const id = String(c.PILOT_EXTERNAL_SALE_ID || '').trim(); return single && id ? `https://api.fu.do/v1alpha1/sales/${id}` : 'https://api.fu.do/v1alpha1/sales'; })() }}

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Config Piloto').first().json; const single = c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM === true || String(c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM).toLowerCase() === 'true'; return single ? '1' : '20'; })() }}

parameters.name: filter[createdAt]
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Config Piloto').first().json; const on = c.FUDO_API_CREATED_AT_FILTER === true || String(c.FUDO_API_CREATED_AT_FILTER).toLowerCase() === 'true'; const start = String(c.PILOT_START_ISO || '').trim(); const single = c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM === true || String(c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM).toLowerCase() === 'true'; return on && start && !single ? `gte.${start}` : undefined; })() }}

parameters.name: filter[saleState]
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Config Piloto').first().json; const on = c.FUDO_API_SALE_STATE_FILTER === true || String(c.FUDO_API_SALE_STATE_FILTER).toLowerCase() === 'true'; const states = String(c.PILOT_ALLOWED_SALE_STATES || '').trim(); const single = c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM === true || String(c.PILOT_SINGLE_ITEM).toLowerCase() === 'true'; return on && states && !single ? `in.(${states})` : undefined; })() }}

parameters.content:
## Sync incremental (NO activar)
1. Schedule en lugar de Manual.
2. Paginar `page[number]`.
3. Activar cursor `last_sale_created_at` tras run OK con RPC.
4. Política piloto: corte por **createdAt** (no closedAt) → no reprocesa tickets abiertos antes del piloto.

nodes.name: Config Piloto
nodes.notes: Parámetros del piloto. Completar PILOT_START_ISO y, en modo single, sale/item ids. No inventar fechas. Filtros API off hasta probe.

nodes.name: Dry-run Evento Consumo
nodes.notes: Sustituto temporal del RPC. Inspeccionar payload aquí antes de habilitar escrituras.
